_comment: Block atlas manifest — read at startup by client/src/block_atlas.rs.
This file is the ENTIRE contract between the art set and the engine.
To ship a new set: drop 64x64 PNGs in this folder, then edit `tiles`
(name -> file) and `kinds` (block kind -> which tile each face wears).
No Rust change, no rebuild. `tile_px` may change too, as long as it is
even. Tiles are packed with a wrapped gutter, so every tile must be
SEAMLESS. Face keys: `all` sets top+side+bottom; `top`/`side`/`bottom`
override it.
Art set + hue rationale: see PALETTE.md and docs/material-palette.md
TWO GROUPS of kinds below, and the difference matters:
* hero kinds (plank, floorboard, log, roof_tile, plaster) - addressed by
name from hero.rs / the beauty scene, which builds cube meshes.
* WORLD kinds - named exactly after a sim BlockId (see sim/src/block.rs
`name()`). client/src/voxel.rs looks a block up BY ITS OWN NAME, so a
gameplay block gets file art the moment a kind with its name appears
here, and falls back to the procedural tile when one does not. That is
the whole wiring: no Rust-side alias table to keep in sync.
2026-08-17 second pass: dirt/brick/lamp/red_sand/snow promoted to file art
(all confirmed used by maps/beach_dusk.json + maps/glass_demo.json).
`water` and `metal` tiles are ALSO shipped below even though neither is a
real sim BlockId yet (grep sim/src/block.rs::name() - no match, and
client/src/voxel.rs never sets metallic > 0.0 today) - they were requested
by name for the golden-hour palette and are ready the moment a BlockId
lands; until then their `kinds` entries are simply never looked up.
Blocks still on procedural tiles (no kind here yet): clay, gravel,
cobblestone, obsidian, moss. `stone` currently borrows stone_bricks - it
reads as masonry, not as natural rock; drop a stone_rough.png in and
repoint it when the set grows.
2026-08-18 PBR upgrade (Monanisa): every tile went 16x16 -> 64x64 with
real per-material structure (mortar courses, wood grain fibers, log
rings, individual sand/dirt grains), redrawn from scratch, same HSV
targets as before so the palette didn't move. Each tile entry below also
gained `normal` (<name>_n.png, tangent-space normal map) and `roughness`
(<name>_r.png, grayscale, white=rough/black=mirror-smooth) generated from
a height field authored in the SAME per-pixel pass as the albedo, so the
bump/gloss detail is tied to real drawn structure, not decorrelated
noise. `TileEntry` in block_atlas.rs has no `deny_unknown_fields`, so
these two extra keys are inert until a loader reads them - the render
lane (Poppy) owns wiring PBR sampling into the pipeline. Old 16x16 set
backed up verbatim at assets/textures/blocks_16px_backup/. Generator:
scripts/_pixel_blocks_gen64.py (deterministic, same seeding scheme as
the retired scripts/_pixel_blocks_gen.py).
